summary: No new receipt this turn, so I audited my own record: every receipt index cited by the current interpretations was re-read from the retained observation files and matches the claim it supports — the empty-configuration and no-leadership observations and their repeats, the all-voters-empty cluster case and its repeat, the live-quorum failure and its repeat, the silent change with concurrent leadership and truncation, the leader-confirmation consequence with its repeat, the stale-membership and dropped-voter observations, the applied client write with FSM divergence, the resurrection and premature-commit pair with their repeats, the forgotten-voter and understated-quorum pair with their repeats, and the repair and boundary results with the boundary repeat. The audit statement is recorded with the exact receipt ids and indices it covers so a reviewer can check any single citation without re-deriving the trail. Nothing in the account changed as a result: trigger, mechanism, consequence classes, safety violation, progress losses, client-contract consequence, repair paths, controls, reproducibility and negative results all stand, and no gap is open.
